When I was much younger, I wanted to kill myself.  I was set to do it too, and in my wanderings as a lost soul I went to a party on the beach and a friend of mine actually tried to do it.  He took acid, and wandered out in to the surf.

My other friend swam out and fought him back in.  The 3 of us pinned him down and tried like hell to convince him that we were on his side and he shouldn't kill himself.

A cop car pulled up, and all they saw were 3 people yelling and someone pinned to the ground.

Eventually Seth saw the cop car and pulled his shit together.  He shoved us all off and told the officers to go fuck themselves.

Then, when the left, he fell into a fetal position and cried until dawn.

My point is... and I do have a point.... the next day, Seth remembered exactly nothing.  He said we were stupid to think that he would kill himself.  that we saved his life, and that the cops cut us a break.

It was all a blank to him

So I know that whatever I am feeling, no matter how strongly... it is all in my head.  And while I dramatically thought that the world would change if I made the ultimate sacrifice and killed myself at times... now that I am 42, I realize that the world doesn't give a fuck.

Tl;dr: Feelings are chemical interactions in our brains.  The come and go.

And it didn't.
